questions.question:
Select the correct idiom that can substitute the italicised group of words in the given sentence.
You must not participate in the marathon this year without any training. It is an unreal hope on your part!
questions.solution:
B)a pipe dream(idiom) – An unreal hope असत्य आशा
carry/take coals to Newcastle(phrase) – to supply something to a place or person that already has a lot of that particular thing
a will-o’-the-wisp(phrase) – something that is impossible to get or achieve
lose one’s temper(phrase) – to get angry अपना आपा खोना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.
I just went to Bali on a backpacking trip and did everything by the ear without any itinerary.
questions.solution: B)'by the ear'के बदले 'by improvisation' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि इस संदर्भ में वाक्य का तात्पर्य है कि कोई योजना बिना किसी निर्धारित योजना के कुछ भी कर रहा है।

questions.question:

options: If you oversleep, you are likely to lose a job

questions.solution: D)You snooze, you lose(idiom) – If you are not alert, you are likely to miss opportunities अगर आप सतर्क नहीं हैं, तो आप अवसर को खो सकते हैं

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Back against the wall

questions.question:

questions.solution: A) It turns out to be a blessing in disguise(idiom) – Has a good effect even though at first it seemed it would be badइसका प्रभाव अच्छा है, भले ही पहले ऐसा लगा कि यह बुरा होगा
